evidence.q: If the speaker hid, the Gate paused, and fog gathered over the water.
Round after round, borders shrank into neighborhoods; together neighbors learned to name limits, disclose plans, and forgive past gaps, thanking the other for every growth.
Solis shivered, wondering if Terra had grown greedy.

But the Creator spoke from the stars: "Do not judge the spirit by the wind's theft. Look to the enduring cycle." 

They learned to forgive the scattered winds.

That night the river spirit rose in the shape of a heron. “Why did you offer everything first?” it asked Mira.

“Because an ember cannot grow inside a closed fist,” she said.
“And why return what you might keep?”
From then on, travelers trusted boldly, shared the river’s gift fairly, and treated uncertain glimmers as mist, not malice.

"Do you not grow weary?" asked a visiting stream. "You give sixty even to those who returned less. You keep your forty-three percentage even when partners send sparingly."

"I am not responding to individuals," the River answered. "I am teaching the Valley itself. Every time I send sixty despite disappointment, I demonstrate that trust can persist. Every time I return forty-three fairly, I show that receivers need not exploit."
Another agent who received generosity from you may send more boldly next round to their new partner. One who saw your fair return may reciprocate likewise.

We are collectively answering the question: what kind of valley shall we become? Your consistency is your vote. Send sixty, return forty-three, and you cast your voice for a valley of steady trust and balanced fairness, one partnership at a time.
The Circle of Shared Breath hummed softly, teaching that generosity lives with prudence, and prudence grows in generosity's shade.
When a traveler hoarded, the current gathered stones and the market slowed;

The Reed Wraith urged her to keep them, promising one splendid night.

Instead, Liora returned half. “The hand that opens the wheel deserves to prosper,” she said, “and the hand that receives must also retain enough to welcome tomorrow.”

He taught the ferrymen to begin boldly when remembered deeds gave reason, to reward entrusted risk with balance, and to pardon small distortions carried by spray. But if greed hardened into custom, they were to narrow the crossing until fairness returned.
